lines.en: I trot across the dry ground.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴平衡着每一步。
lines.en: My tail balances every step.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙地走，影子很扁。
lines.en: I keep low on the sand, shadow flat.

lines.zh: 爪子陷进沙里，又拔出来。
lines.en: My claws sink into sand and pull free.

lines.zh: 我在干河床的裂缝里走
lines.en: I walk in the cracks of the dry riverbed.
I walk close to the dry grass roots.
I go around a clump of dry grass.
I move in quick small steps, never far.
I crouch low and probe forward.
My narrow prints mark the sand.
One foot hangs; I don't set it down.

lines.zh: 我折回去，检查刚才的路。
lines.en: I double back to check the trail.

lines.zh: 我的身体结构适合蹲着避暑。
lines.en: My build suits crouching out of the heat.
I find shade and slip into it.
I lie on the sand; the heat is right.
I rest my chin on my forefeet.
I wait for something small to pass.
Wind pushes sand over my feet.

lines.zh: 我伏在沙上，和石头一样。
lines.en: I lie on the sand, just like a stone.
My snout is working.
This is the hottest part of the day.
I tuck myself in a little.
There is a lizard in the distance.
I stay down and narrow my eyes.
I lie there, lids slowly closing.
Something stirred by the dry bed.
My tail lies against the ground.
I won't move before the sun shifts.
You are blocking my shade.
You are too large for me to bite.
I lie still with my eyes on you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子压着我的尾巴尖。
lines.en: Your boot is on my tail tip.
You've just drunk; I can tell.
Small — but my teeth aren't.
One more step and I run.
This dry ground is mine.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我的身子长
lines.en: Your shadow is longer than my body.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你腰上的影子
lines.en: I tilt my head to the shadow at your waist.
What is that in your hand?
You reach out; I shrink back.

lines.zh: 我在沙上刨出一个小坑
lines.en: I claw out a small hollow in the sand.
I am too small for that.
I duck into the rock crack behind me.
Sand has got into the wound.
I swallow the cry back down.
I shake and sand falls off.

lines.zh: 我的一条后腿使不上力
lines.en: One hind leg won't take my weight.
I limp toward the rock crack.
I still need to be able to run.

lines.zh: 这一下我记在爪子上了。
lines.en: I have marked that one in my claws.
I smell a little meat.

lines.zh: 我鼻子抽了两下，又近了
lines.en: I sniff twice and edge closer.
It is moving; good.
Just set it on the sand.
I'll even eat a dead bug.
Let me touch it with my tongue first.
Don't move; I will come.
Better than bugs, by far.
I will snatch it and run.
Is there more? I want more.
You bumped me and I tipped over.
I am too small to shift you.
The bump raises a small cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我退开，抖了抖身上的沙。
lines.en: I back off and shake the sand off.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟蹭掉我一层皮
lines.en: Your heel scrapes a layer off my hide.
I press to the ground and you miss me.
After the bump I take another direction.
We touched, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我从你两脚之间挤过去
lines.en: I squeeze between your feet.
Stop trying to step on me.
That depends on the season.
Kin are hard to find on dry ground.
I need to eat first.
That is a hard question on dry ground.
I tilt my head and walk off.
I am the only one around here.
My build is too small for that.
Ask when the rains come.

lines.zh: 旱地上没有谁教过我这个
lines.en: No one taught me this on dry ground.
Sand covers my ears.
I drag it into the grass with my teeth.
It is bigger than I am.
I drag it back into the sand hollow.

lines.zh: 我用短小的前爪按住它。
lines.en: I pin it with a short forefoot.
Too hard; I cannot bite it.

lines.zh: 这地方别的家伙找不到
lines.en: Nothing else will find it here.
A bite, then a glance up.
Dropped it; I pick it up again.
Smells like another animal's meat.
Good; it is stowed.
Something moved in the dry grass.
I flatten and fix on the grass.
I flatten and creep forward.
That lizard is one bite for me.
I close in half a step at a time.
The wind blows toward it; good.
I flatten and move only my eyes.
I crouch, ready to dash.
It's bent over its pack.
Now; break out.
I spring out of the sand.
One step closer and I spring.
Its shadow falls in front of me.
It has just looked back.
I follow low along the ground.
It runs for the low scrub.
I am better suited to this ground.
My short steps are quick.
I wait for its next footfall.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的旧脚印过去
lines.en: I step in my own old prints.
The sand covers my prints.
It keeps watching the other way.
Another half step closer.

lines.zh: 它的脚在原地换了两下
lines.en: Its feet shift twice in place.
I come out from behind the dry grass.
The last stretch.
It runs, and I give chase.
My endurance is better than its.
The hard sun helps me.
I dart into the blind spot behind its leg.
The bite is small but sharp.
It flings me off.
I land on the sand and roll.
I lunge low and bite the ankle.
It backs two steps; I follow.

lines.zh: 我的爪子划破了它的皮。
lines.en: My claws open its skin.
Its tail sweeps; I duck.
Once I bite, I do not let go.
It stomps; I roll clear.
Panting, I get up.
I need one more try.
That will have hurt it.
It runs off; I cannot keep up.
I push my snout out of the sand first.
The sun is fierce; just right.
This is Jurassic dry country.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩身子，沙落下来
lines.en: I shake and the sand slides off.
I first look around, keeping low.
There is wind along the dry bed.
I am not large, but I am quick.
Something stirs in the dry grass.
I find shade and crouch.
The smell here is dry.
I start moving in short steps.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在沙上划了一道。
lines.en: My tail draws a line in the sand.
Under the sand, I hear the shaking first.
Lie low and stay still.
The sun has shifted a little.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地、慢慢地探出头。
lines.en: I poke my head out, slowly.
This place will hide me.
The sand's still warm; I can run a while.
Fire sweeps my back; it is hot.

lines.zh: 坡上的碎石跟着我一起滚
lines.en: The scree rolls down with me.
My short legs can't reach the bottom.
The blast throws me into the sand.
An arrow pins my hind leg.
Something unseen holds me down.

lines.zh: 旱地上没吃的，我越来越轻。
lines.en: Nothing to eat on this dry ground.

lines.zh: 雷打在附近，我缩进坑里。
lines.en: Lightning strikes nearby and I shrink into a hollow.
I fall, all four claws grasping.
